[[File:Solar_ionization_reactor.png|thumb|right|200px|A solar ionization reactor on an Imperial-class Star Destroyer]]
A '''solar ionization reactor''' was a reactor that used [[Hypermatter/Legends|hypermatter]] to create a miniature [[Star/Legends|star]] inside the reaction chamber to draw energy from. It was seen on multiple models of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] and [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]].

The [[I-a2b solar ionization reactor/Legends|I-a2b solar ionization reactor]] and the [[I-a3b solar ionization reactor]] were both ionization reactors.
